Morgan: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to @Maya and @Juno for covering tonight's on-call and organizing surprise bagels this morning. saved my late demo run :heart: :bagel:
Maya: aw shucks, team effort. Eli actually did the tea run at 7am, and Sam helped move chairs for the demo setup :coffee: :chair:
Eli: i only restocked tea and broke one mug, oops. glad it helped! :grimacing:
Sam: Amazing work all around. quick poll: do we want bagels or croissants next time? react with :bagel: for bagels, :croissant: for croissants.
Juno: also — tiny plant PSA: philodendron by the window is thirsty. i watered it this morning, but can we add a rotation on the whiteboard? (otherwise i'll be the unofficial plant nanny) :seedling:
Morgan: adding a sticky to the kitchen board now. also +1 for a plant rota, less guilt for Juno :raised_hands:
Eli: +1 bagels but croissant for a special day. can we do both if procurement approves? :pray:
Sam: noted. i'll make a quick poll in #kitchen later if folks want to weigh in.
Maya: thanks everyone who jumped in — on-call coverage, snacks, demo moves. small things that keep the product demos smooth. :tada:
DeployBot: deploy redwood/frontend v1.42.3 by maya completed successfully at 2025-03-12T09:12:03Z (automated note)
Morgan: bringing this back to main thread — if anyone else wants to be on the plant rota, drop a note here or scribble on the kitchen board. thanks again team! :sparkles:
